next.reason: 1985: "The number of digit positions that can be described by the PICTURE character-string must range from 1 to 18 inclusive"; 2023: "the number of digit positions described by character-string-1 shall range from 1 through 31.". The symbol set 9, P, S, V and the digit-content rule are carried over, but the maximum number of digit positions rises from 18 to 31, so more programs are accepted.
